name: Tunisian Lamb Soup
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical soup recipes with 500g meat + 1L stock + vegetables/pasta yielding 4 adult main-dish servings
Total time is sum of sequential steps: browning lamb (~5 min) + sautéing aromatics (~5 min) + simmering (~20 min) + cooking pasta (~15 min); no parallel timing or passive time assumed
Chicken stock classified as non-vegetarian/vegan/pescatarian due to animal origin
Macaroni classified as containing wheat (durum wheat pasta)
Harissa spice blend left ambiguous for sesame (possible in some blends but not specified)
No milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, or soy ingredients listed
Spinach, tomato puree, chickpeas, and lemon juice compatible with all listed diets except where meat/stock conflict
Salt, pepper, cumin, and garlic have no impact on diet or allergen flags
instructions:
Add the lamb to a casserole and cook over high heat. When browned, remove from the heat and set aside.
Keep a tablespoon of fat in the casserole and discard the rest. Reduce to medium heat then add the garlic, onion and spinach and cook until the onion is translucent and the spinach wilted or about 5 minutes.
Return the lamb to the casserole with the onion-spinach mixture, add the tomato puree, cumin, harissa, chicken, chickpeas, lemon juice, salt and pepper in the pan. Simmer over low heat for about 20 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook for 15 minutes or until pasta is cooked.

ingredients.name: Lamb Mince
ingredients.assumptions: Raw lamb mince, typical 20% fat content; values for uncooked weight as added to casserole.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 2 average garlic cloves minced; standard raw garlic nutrient profile.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium onion (approx 110g), peeled and chopped; raw onion values.

ingredients.name: Spinach
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh spinach leaves as added; raw spinach nutrient density before wilting.

ingredients.name: Tomato Puree
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons tomato puree/paste (approx 15g per tbsp); concentrated tomato values.

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon ground cumin; standard dry spice nutrition per teaspoon scaled.

ingredients.name: Chicken Stock
ingredients.assumptions: 1 litre chicken stock; low-calorie broth values assuming standard commercial or homemade without added fat.

ingredients.name: Harissa Spice
ingredients.assumptions: 3 teaspoons harissa spice blend (approx 3g per tsp); typical North African chili-garlic-spice mix values.

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice

ingredients.name: Macaroni
